contract.note: Rookie contract as a first-round pick; specific years/value not found in sources searched.

scheme.note: Rams' offense run by McVay; Simpson drafted as developmental QB behind Matthew Stafford.

competition.name: Matthew Stafford
competition.note: Publicly committed to returning for his 18th NFL season in 2026 ('I enjoy playing too much to hang it up'); no retirement imminent. This makes Simpson QB2/3 with no near-term path to starting.

competition.name: Stetson Bennett
competition.status: Competing with Simpson for QB2 role
competition.note: Per ProFootballRumors (2026-06), Bennett and Simpson are competing for the Rams' QB2 job. Some reports (Athlon Sports, heavy.com) indicate Simpson was pulling ahead / McVay 'put Bennett on notice' during camp; Bennett's roster spot described as 'uncertain' in some SI Rams Digest pieces.

competition.name: Jimmy Garoppolo
competition.status: On roster, reportedly shut down for preseason
competition.note: SI Rams Digest headline references 'Rams' Jimmy Garoppolo shut down for preseason, Stetson Bennett could win QB2 role' -- suggests Garoppolo may not be full QB2 competition, increasing path for Simpson or Bennett.

notes: Drafted by the Rams in Round 1, Pick 13 of the 2026 NFL Draft out of Alabama -- a notable first-round investment at QB despite Stafford entrenched as starter.
College stats (final Alabama season): 305 completions, 3,567 passing yards, 28 TD-5 INT, 64.5% completion.
Simpson quote on draft night: 'Learning from (head coach) Sean McVay, and then (quarterback) Matthew (Stafford), who is obviously one of the greatest of all time, I'm looking forward to it.'
No NFL regular-season workload yet (rookie, has not played a regular season snap as of 2026-08-11).

injury.note: No injury reports found for Simpson in 2026 camp coverage.
